focus.title: This Week's Focus
items: Get FieldSync live (just needs Netlify env vars)
Decide on AVA Arena display hardware specs

items.text: The AVA Arena competition idea has legs. Before building, consider: do you want family vs family competition, or within-family competition? Changes the social dynamics a lot.
FieldSync is 90% done but stalled on deployment. Want to knock that out first before starting new stuff? Quick win.
What if AVA Buddy (the plush) had a 'mood' that reflects the kid's BG? Happy face in range, sleepy face when low, etc. More emotional connection than just numbers.
